主体设定：<Subject 1> 是 <Picture 1> 画面左侧的男性，保留束起的发髻、短须与沉静的脸，宽大厚重、袍摆拖地的深色长袍，腰间一长一短两柄刀，右手长刀；<Subject 2> 是 <Picture 1> 画面右侧的男性，保留束起的发髻与清瘦的脸，深色衣装外肩披边缘毛糙的粗布披风，刀柄垂着绳穗，右手长刀；<Subject 3> 是 <Picture 1> 中的竹林空地：湿透的深色石板地、贴地的雾、两侧密集竹林。动作中两人的身份与整套服装不变。

概述：[参考生成] 风从左吹向右的竹林空地上，<Subject 1> 以长刀大弧守住身前一整圈刀圈，一步一刀向前压；<Subject 2> 要破开这道刀圈、贴进他一步之内。前者斩倒竹子封住后者的路线，后者借倒竹与弯竹的回弹两次突入，最后用刀柄撞落对方的长刀，两人在新位置继续交锋。

视觉：写实电影质感，低饱和青灰冷调，雾、湿地反光与竹林纵深层层分明，冷白天光从竹林顶端漫下勾出两人轮廓。两人都束发、衣着深色，以短须与厚袍、清瘦与披风区分，换位后也不混淆。刀刀相撞的火星是全片唯一的暖色，只在接触点一闪即灭，不是光效；竹子倒下的方向由斩击方向决定。空地右侧竹林边那根最粗的竹竿是固定地标，全片位置不变。无血，画面无文字水印。

[Shot 1] 贴地低位广景，从右侧竹林边穿过前景竹竿看向空地，雾被风拉成贴地的带子。<Subject 1> 从左侧压来，长刀一记大弧扫满身前；<Subject 2> 从右侧低身冲进，刀尖直取他的前膝。大弧的刀背砸在 <Subject 2> 刀身中段，把刀尖压进积水、划出一道水线，火星与水花同时炸起，<Subject 2> 被弹回刀圈外。他借回弹再冲，<Subject 1> 不砍人，横刀齐腰斩断他前方两根竹竿，竹子一前一后横倒封路；<Subject 2> 贴着湿石板从第一根竹子下方滑过，水花扇形铺开，第二根正从他头顶压下。

[Shot 2] 00:05.000 切绕行的全身机位，刚倒下的竹竿仍横在两人之间，那根最粗的竹竿在画面右侧。<Subject 2> 一脚蹬上正在倒下的竹竿，借倾倒变向跃起，从高处斜劈；<Subject 1> 双手横刀架在头顶，两刀相交处迸出火星，这一劈的分量把他压得单膝砸进积水。他借最低的重心整身一拧，肩膀由下往上撞进 <Subject 2> 胸口；<Subject 2> 倒飞出去，后背撞上那根最粗的竹竿，竹子整根弯到极限、竹叶倾泻。竹子回弹，把他整个人弹回来，正迎上 <Subject 1> 刚抡满的第二记大弧：两刀正撞，<Subject 2> 的刀几乎脱手，手腕被砸得向后折，身体被带着转了半圈。<Subject 1> 的长刀停在弧尾，厚袍慢半拍向后甩开，持刀手的另一侧露出空门。

[Shot 3] 00:10.000 切更低、更广的视角，地上横着被斩倒的竹竿与一道道水痕。<Subject 2> 顺着这半圈旋转压到最低，从还没收回的长刀下方钻进刀圈，贴到 <Subject 1> 持刀手的另一侧，两人左右换位。他反手用刀柄尾端猛撞长刀的护手根部：刀先被撞得一偏，才从 <Subject 1> 右手脱出，翻转着甩过 <Subject 2> 肩头，扎进那根最粗的竹竿，刀身震颤，竹叶纷落。<Subject 1> 左手已拔出腰间短刀横在身前，<Subject 2> 后撤半步沉低，刀尖对准他，两人随即再次移动脚步。扎在竹上的长刀保留在身后，两人的面孔、衣装与新的站位都清楚。

声音：风穿竹林的持续呼啸与竹叶沙沙声，湿石板上的脚步与滑行水声，长刀大弧沉厚的破风、快刀尖细的哨音，刀刀相撞的金属炸响，竹竿断裂的脆响与弯竹回弹的弹响，刀柄撞上护手的一记钝响，长刀扎进竹竿后的余颤。无对白或喊招式名。配乐以低沉太鼓与尺八渐紧，仅在长刀被撞脱手时加入一次重鼓。

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1>: 韩磊, the person in <Picture 1>, young East Asian man in his late 20s, messy black textured short hair, clean-shaven, slim build, wearing beige knit sweater over khaki collared shirt, khaki trousers, white sneakers; calm rational demeanor with restrained intensity.
<Subject 2>: 锦华苑1301室, the environment in <Picture 2>, 韩磊's apartment: bedroom with bed/nightstand, living room with toolbox on floor, large window city view; night warm 2700K lamp / early morning cool 5000K natural light.
<Subject 3>: 强电井内部, the environment in <Picture 3>, electrical room interior (电井.png): concrete walls, metal cable trays with colored cables, two rows of six white smart electric meters (3 upper + 3 lower), grey metal storage cabinet below, ceiling round light, concrete floor; narrow enclosed space, industrial utilitarian.
<Subject 4>: 强电井门口, the environment in <Picture 4>, electrical room doorway (强电井门口过): grey polished marble tile floor, beige textured walls, grey metal louver electrical room door (with old loose padlock being replaced), 1302 dark brown door adjacent, stainless steel elevator; morning 4000K ceiling light.

summary:
[reference generation] 14.5s; fast montage pacing, 16:9, 3D stylized CG realistic with PBR materials, D2 pronounced camera enhancement, over-limit strategy B (compressed). Multi-scene montage: night 1301 bedroom → dawn electrical room interior → day 3 1301 living room → electrical room doorway. Night 11:30pm: 韩磊 lies in bed holding phone above face, APP real-time electricity numbers ticking up; throws phone onto pillow, sits up, stares at ceiling, delivers "拆个寂寞，当老子耳旁风呢。". Dawn 6am: 韩磊 crouches inside <Subject 3> electrical room, toolbox on floor; installs small lock hasp on his main circuit breaker, applies red seal strip, wraps black electrical tape around cover seam; VO "封条加绝缘胶，但凡是个要体面的正常人，都不好意思拿剪刀硬捅。" (lips closed, hands/objects close-up only). Day 3 morning: 韩磊 grabs phone, APP refreshes "昨夜用电量 8.2 度"; takes new padlock from toolbox, goes out; at <Subject 4> electrical room doorway, removes old loose padlock, installs new padlock, "咔哒" clicks shut, tugs twice, puts key in jeans pocket, pats pocket. Audio-only dialogue + VO; no subtitles, no BGM.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> 韩磊 (Shots 1-4): Opening: lying in bed in <Subject 2> bedroom at night, phone held above face. Changes: stares at APP numbers ticking → throws phone onto pillow → turns and sits up on bed edge → stares at ceiling → delivers frustrated line (live dialogue, not VO) → cut to dawn 6am: crouching inside <Subject 3> electrical room, toolbox open on concrete floor → installs lock hasp → applies red seal → wraps black tape (VO throughout, hands only, no face) → cut to day 3: sitting on bed edge → grabs phone from nightstand → checks APP → goes to living room → opens toolbox → takes new brass padlock → walks out → cut to <Subject 4> electrical room doorway: crouches → removes old loose padlock → installs new padlock → clicks shut → tugs twice → puts key in jeans pocket → pats pocket. Final: crouching/standing at <Subject 4> electrical room doorway, new padlock secured, key in pocket, calm satisfied determined.
<Subject 2> 锦华苑1301室 (Shots 1, 3): Night bedroom: bed, nightstand, warm lamp, phone screen glow. Day 3 living room: toolbox on floor, new padlock. Cool morning light.
<Subject 3> 强电井内部 (Shot 2): Dawn 6am. Concrete walls, metal cable trays, two rows of six white smart meters, grey storage cabinet, ceiling light. 韩磊 crouching at meter/circuit breaker area, toolbox on concrete floor. Narrow enclosed space.
<Subject 4> 强电井门口 (Shot 4): Morning. Grey metal louver door with hasp. Old loose padlock removed, new brass padlock installed. 1302 door adjacent, elevator visible. 4000K ceiling light.

detailed_description:
Fast montage across 3 days and 4 locations. VO constraint for Shot 2: The character says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>原文</d> while his lips remain completely closed. VO shots use hands/objects close-up, overhead angles, no face/upper-body frontal. Live dialogue in Shot 1 (staring at ceiling) may show face but not looking at camera. During dialogue, speaker visually dominant. Camera is observer. No lens-looking. Only <d> content spoken. Every camera move carries new information. No BGM; audio-only dialogue; no subtitles.

[Shot 1] <Subject 1> 韩磊 in <Subject 2> 1301 bedroom at night: medium shot from foot of bed → medium close-up side angle, 35mm→50mm f/2.8, focus on 韩磊 lying then sitting up staring at ceiling; phone screen glow on face; <Subject 2> bedroom dim warm 2700K lamp. <Subject 2> night: warm lamp, phone screen brightest. Fast cut + static — trigger: lie bed APP ticking → throw phone → sit up → stare ceiling → deliver line; rapid cuts 0.8s each for action, then static 2.0s for dialogue. Composition: (a) night 11:30pm → 韩磊 lies on back in bed → right hand holds smartphone above face → APP real-time electricity page visible on screen → digital number ticks up one increment (fast compressed, "tick") → (b) 韩磊 throws phone onto pillow beside head (phone bounces) → turns body → sits up on bed edge → (c) medium close-up side angle: 韩磊 sits on bed edge → back slightly hunched → stares upward at ceiling (not at camera, frustrated monologue to ceiling) → jaw tight → delivers line, angry frustrated with dark humor. Expression: 韩磊 — strong tier, sitting on bed edge, back hunched (frustrated exhaustion), staring at ceiling (venting to no one), jaw tight, speaking angry frustrated with dark humor, "拆个寂寞" sarcastic (they didn't actually拆), "当老子耳旁风呢" angry (they ignored his demand), ending rising with frustrated anger. Listener orientation: eyes target ceiling (looking up, venting monologue, no listener present), head tilted up, mouth projection toward ceiling/room. Dialogue sync: 韩磊 speaking with lip-sync, staring at ceiling throughout. 韩磊 (S1): young male, mid-range, chest resonance, clear Mandarin, ~4.5 chars/sec (angry frustrated, dark humor); "拆个寂寞" sarcastic, "当老子耳旁风呢" angry, ending rising frustration. Says: <d>拆个寂寞，当老子耳旁风呢。</d> SFX: phone screen number ticking faint "tick", phone thrown onto pillow "thud", bed sheets rustling (sync sitting up), bedroom silence amplifying frustration. Environment: <Subject 2> bedroom night ambience (silent, distant city hum), warm lamp. Duration: 3.5 seconds.

[Shot 2] At 00:03.500, <Subject 1> 韩磊's hands in <Subject 3> 强电井内部 at dawn 6am: fast montage of hands/objects close-up + overhead angle, 85mm→100mm f/2.8, shallow/extremely shallow DOF, focus on hands installing lock hasp, applying red seal, wrapping black tape, thumb pressing edge; 韩磊's sweater cuffs and khaki trousers visible (crouching), NO FACE visible; <Subject 3> electrical room concrete walls, white smart meters, metal cable trays with colored cables in background. <Subject 3> dawn: ceiling round light 4000K on, concrete walls lit, narrow enclosed space. Overhead + close-up static cuts — trigger: install hasp → apply red seal → wrap black tape (3 circles) → thumb press edge; VO throughout; rapid close-up cuts 1.0-1.2s each, no camera movement within cuts, all hands/objects only, no face. Composition: dawn 6am → <Subject 3> electrical room interior (concrete walls, white smart meters on wall, metal cable trays with red/yellow/blue cables, grey storage cabinet below, ceiling round light) → 韩磊 crouching (only hands/lower arms/knees visible from overhead) → toolbox open on concrete floor → (a) right hand takes small metal lock hasp → positions hasp on his home's main circuit breaker (入户总闸, among the white meters/breakers) → secures hasp (click) → (b) left hand takes red seal strip → peels backing → applies red seal strip across circuit breaker cover seam (red strip visible, smooth on grey metal) → presses flat with thumb → (c) right hand takes roll of black electrical tape → unwinds tape → wraps black tape around circuit breaker cover seam (first circle, second circle, third circle overlapping) → on third circle, thumb presses tape edge firmly → thumbnail scrapes across joint to secure → circuit breaker now fully secured: lock hasp + red seal + black tape. VO plays throughout all cuts, lips closed (no face visible, hands only). The character says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>封条加绝缘胶，但凡是个要体面的正常人，都不好意思拿剪刀硬捅。</d> while his lips remain completely closed. SFX: lock hasp clicking into place "click", seal strip peeling "peel", seal pressing flat "press", electrical tape unwinding "zzzzt", tape wrapping "wrap-wrap", thumb pressing tape "press", thumbnail scraping across tape "scrape-scrape". Environment: <Subject 3> electrical room interior ambience (confined space echo, faint electrical hum from meters), ceiling light. Duration: 5.5 seconds.

[Shot 3] At 00:09.000, <Subject 1> 韩磊 in <Subject 2> 1301 living room at day 3 morning: fast montage close-up → medium, 85mm→35mm f/2.8, focus on phone screen APP "8.2度" then hand taking new padlock from toolbox; <Subject 2> living room cool 5000K morning light, toolbox on floor. <Subject 2> day 3: cool morning natural light from window. Fast cuts + static — trigger: grab phone → APP 8.2度 → take new padlock → walk out; rapid cuts 0.8s each. Composition: (a) day 3 morning → close-up of 韩磊's hand grabbing phone from nightstand → thumb swipes → APP page refreshes → "昨夜用电量 8.2 度" displayed on screen (8.2 pronounced "八点二") → (b) medium shot living room: 韩磊 crouches → opens toolbox on floor → right hand takes new brass padlock (shiny, unused) → stands → walks toward entry door → opens door → walks out (determined stride). No dialogue. SFX: phone grabbing, thumb swiping screen "swipe", toolbox opening "click", padlock metal clink "clink", door opening "creak", footsteps walking out "step-step". Environment: <Subject 2> living room morning ambience. Duration: 2.0 seconds.

[Shot 4] At 00:11.000, <Subject 1> 韩磊 at <Subject 4> 强电井门口: medium close-up from side, 50mm f/2.8, shallow DOF, focus on 韩磊 crouching at electrical room door, removing old lock, installing new padlock, clicking shut, tugging, putting key in pocket, patting pocket; grey metal louver door, 1302 door adjacent in background. <Subject 4> morning 4000K light; hands and lock lit. Very slight push-in + static — trigger: remove old lock → install new → click → tug → key in pocket → pat pocket; camera pushes ~0.1m over 3.5s, subject scale ~50%→56%. Composition: 韩磊 crouches at <Subject 4> grey metal louver electrical room door → right hand removes old loose padlock from door hasp (old lock dangling, loose, brass worn) → sets old lock aside → left hand positions new brass padlock onto hasp → pushes lock shackle into lock body → "咔哒" sharp click shut → lock secured → 韩磊 tugs new padlock twice with right hand (pulling hard, lock doesn't move, secure) → takes key from lock (key attached) → puts key into right jeans pocket → pats pocket twice (confirming key is there) → looks at secured lock → calm satisfied determined. No dialogue. SFX: old padlock removing metal clink "clink", new padlock shackle closing "咔哒" (sharp click, sync), tugging lock "tug-tug" (metal strain, lock doesn't move), key putting in pocket clothing rustle, patting pocket "pat-pat". Environment: <Subject 4> hallway morning ambience (elevator hum, ceiling light). Duration: 3.5 seconds.

overall_soundscape:
Multi-location montage: <Subject 2> bedroom night (warm lamp silence, phone tick, phone throw, bed rustle) → <Subject 3> electrical room dawn (confined echo, electrical hum, lock hasp click, seal peel, tape unwind, thumb press, nail scrape) → <Subject 2> living room day 3 (cool morning, phone swipe, toolbox click, padlock clink, door creak, footsteps) → <Subject 4> electrical room doorway morning (hallway hum, old lock clink, new lock "咔哒", tugging, pocket rustle, patting). One voice: 韩磊 angry frustrated live dialogue (Shot 1, staring ceiling) + calm rational VO (Shot 2, lips closed, hands only). Fast montage across 3 days and 4 locations. No nonverbal vocal sounds beyond dialogue/VO.
